Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this game and this tournament. The tournament favourites India Women have come out on top. We hope you enjoyed our company. Until next time, goodbye and take care.

It is India Women who have won the gold medal. They though were expected to excel in this sport and they have done so. 117 was always going to be tough but Chamari Athapaththu started off well. However, the pacers were brilliant with the new ball, especially, Titas Sadhu. Hasini Perera and Nilakshi de Silva did keep Lanka's hopes alive but India kept picking wickets when needed. In the end, it was a tough ask for the lower order and India Women came out on top quite comfortably.

That's the GOLD MEDAL for Indian Women. Short of a length outside off, Udeshika Prabodhani punches it to sweeper cover for a single. The India Women players collect to celebrate the first ever GOLD MEDAL in cricket in their maiden participation in the Asian Games Cricket.
